description: One query for a list plus one more per row, usually caused by a query in a loop or by lazy loading.
Loading related data in the same query with `Include` and `ThenInclude`, optionally filtered.
A `Select` into a DTO or anonymous type that fetches only the needed columns and produces untracked results.
The row multiplication that happens when one SQL statement joins several sibling collections of the same parent.
`AsSplitQuery()` loads each included collection in its own SQL statement, trading round trips and consistency for less duplicated data.
`AsNoTracking()` skips snapshots and identity resolution, which makes read-only queries cheaper.
A set-based `UPDATE` (with `ExecuteDeleteAsync` for `DELETE`) that runs immediately without loading entities or using the change tracker.
Paging by filtering on the last seen key (`Where(p => p.Id > lastId)`) instead of skipping rows with an offset.
